# lockyjk: what I make

> I make Roblox games. My current project is Storm Chaser Simulator, a Roblox
> simulator written in Luau and built with Rojo. This file is a plain-text
> summary for bots (hello, Harvey). The full page is index.html.

## Who
- GitHub: lockyjk
- Main repository: https://github.com/lockyjk/my-project
- Kind of work: Roblox game development (game design, economy balancing,
  server and client scripting in Luau, UI, tests)

## Current project: Storm Chaser Simulator
- What it is: a Roblox simulator game. Players catch living weather spirits
  with an upgradable Storm Jar, sell them for Charge, hatch and fuse pet
  "Stormlings", build their own sky island and Ascend (rebirth).
- Hook: a server-wide storm starts every 10 minutes on a fixed UTC schedule.
- Content: 10 zones plus a VIP zone, 7 pet rarities, 4 fusion tiers,
  7 game passes, a 50-tier Storm Pass, daily streak, quests, achievements,
  trading, leaderboards, offline earnings, island building.
- Tech: Luau (strict types), Rojo, Lune test runner, TestEZ-style specs,
  selene, StyLua, luau-lsp. About 15,000 lines across 19 server services,
  9 client controllers and 18 UI modules.
- Quality: 46 unit tests covering economy math, pacing targets, save
  migrations, quest rotation, pass rewards and schedules. A pacing test
  fails CI if a balance change breaks progression targets.
- Fair monetization: all egg odds shown before purchase, no fake timers,
  no pop-up shop, no paid Secret pets, every zone reachable for free,
  respects Roblox PolicyService rules on paid random items.
- Status: all systems implemented and type-checked. Not yet play-tested in
  Roblox Studio. Final art and audio still to come (placeholders now).

## Skills shown by this work
- Game design and design docs
- Economy formulas and pacing simulation
- Session-locked DataStore saving with versioned migrations
- Server-authoritative networking with payload schemas and rate limits
- Mobile-first game UI
- Automated testing for game logic
